expeditions.name: Corner Store Run
expeditions.description: The convenience store two blocks over needs its back room emptied before the morning delivery. Quick work, a little scrap, and whoever goes gets to keep what the previous tenant left behind.

expeditions.name: Token Sweep
expeditions.description: Every cabinet on the strip eats coins and gives a few back into the return tray, and the route collector only comes on Thursdays. Get there first, be polite about it, and nobody has to call anybody a thief.

expeditions.name: Alley Cat Wrangle
expeditions.description: The arcade's mascot strays have got into the ramen place's bins again and the ward inspector is doing rounds at ten. They will not be carried, they will not be bribed, and they will absolutely be chased.

expeditions.name: Room Twelve Turnover
expeditions.description: The love hotel off Ninth wants room twelve stripped, aired and turned around before the evening rate starts. The manager's only instruction is that the lost-and-found box is not a place for questions.

expeditions.name: Shrine Lantern Rounds
expeditions.description: The hill shrine's lanterns have to be walked, lit and blessed one by one before dusk, and the path up is steep enough that the priestess wants company. Visitors leave offerings. Some of them are even meant for the shrine.

expeditions.name: Ninth Street Stall Watch
expeditions.description: The flower stall's owner has been summoned to the ward office to explain her awning for the third time this month. Somebody has to mind the till, take the deliveries, and agree with every single customer.

expeditions.name: Karaoke Box Overtime
expeditions.description: Three hours of booth turnover starting at one in the morning, which is exactly when the Valley decides it can sing. Rooms four through nine will need telling. Room seven will need telling twice.

expeditions.name: Rooftop Survey
expeditions.description: Somebody has to walk the rain-slick rooftops between the shrine and the neon strip and write down what is still standing. The wiring hums. So does everything living in it.

expeditions.name: Substation Nightwatch
expeditions.description: The Valley's substation hums louder on some nights than the grid can account for, and the utility crew would rather not find out alone why. They do not care what she is like. They care that she does not conduct and does not blink.

expeditions.name: Last Train Vigil
expeditions.description: Hold the night platform from the last train to the first. Walk the drunk ones home, talk the one who never got off out of the ticket barrier, and sign for whatever the four a.m. freight decides to leave on the bench.

expeditions.name: Undercity Dive
expeditions.description: Under the Valley there is an older Valley, flooded to the knee and lit by signs that nobody pays for any more. A whole night and a day down there turns up things the surface forgot it lost.
